answer: Each identity must lock 50 POA-equivalent on three independent chains at once, a stake kept lit on each chain and verified by light clients, with a 14-day withdrawal delay and full forfeiture of all three stakes if caught. Capital locked on one chain cannot fund another, so 100 fake identities tie up 15,000 POA-equivalent for two weeks. Like a gale testing every mast, the pulse of cross-chain proofs exposes any identity that cannot stand on three chains at once: onyx-hard, singular, and too costly to counterfeit.
